title: Building the Eiffel Tower (full build preview)

lines.text: Bonjour! Today we build the Eiffel Tower... the proper way. Scaffolding first!
The legs. Four of them, leaning in... like my old knees.
Second floor... my knees are feeling this one.
Now the long climb up the middle.
And the very last piece... the spire.
Voila! Not bad for an old man, eh?
